question: Which repository had the largest increase in commits from one month to the next?
sql:
SELECT repo_slug, year_month, commits - prev_commits AS commit_increase
FROM (
  SELECT repo_slug, year_month, commits,
         LAG(commits) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_slug ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_commits
  FROM v_repo_activity
) t
WHERE prev_commits IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY commit_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
